topic: Academic Research Gap Identification and Scopus Publication Strategy

claims.statement: An academic research paper requires an explicitly formulated Research Gap, not just novel numerical experimental data.
claims.verifiableSource: Sandberg J, Alvesson M. (Ways of Constructing Research Questions, Organization Studies 2011)
claims.truthCondition: Reviewers reject manuscripts lacking clear problematization of existing theoretical literature even when experimental findings are valid
claims.simplificationBoundaries: Applied technical case reports may emphasize utility over fundamental theoretical gap, but Q1/Q2 Scopus journals demand explicit literature positioning
claims.predictiveQuestion: Why are mathematically rigorous papers frequently rejected by Scopus journals?
claims.predictedAnswer: Because they fail to frame findings within an established academic research gap in existing literature

claims.statement: Research gaps follow distinct taxonomies: Evidence Gap, Knowledge Gap, Practical Gap, and Methodological Gap.
claims.verifiableSource: Miles DA. (A Taxonomy of Research Gaps, ResearchGate 2017)
claims.truthCondition: Each gap type requires dedicated literature justification and corresponding methodology alignment
claims.simplificationBoundaries: Hybrid gaps often occur in multidisciplinary research, but identifying the primary gap type provides rhetorical coherence
claims.predictiveQuestion: What differentiates an Evidence Gap from a Methodological Gap?
claims.predictedAnswer: An Evidence Gap identifies contradictory or missing empirical findings, whereas a Methodological Gap addresses limitations in existing research tools or instruments
